description: Header file defining the NinjaCBinaryTargetWriter class for generating ninja build files for C binary targets, including methods for writing compiler flags, module dependencies, precompiled headers, source files, and link dependencies.

classes.name: NinjaCBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for writing ninja build files for C binary targets, handling compiler flags, module dependencies, precompiled headers, source files, and link dependencies.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of writing the ninja build file for the target.

methods.name: WriteCompilerVars
methods.description: Writes all compiler flags including includes, defines, and cflags.

methods.name: WriteModuleDepsSubstitution
methods.description: Writes module dependencies or no-self flags for clang modulemaps.

methods.name: WriteModuleNameSubstitution
methods.description: Writes module name substitution for clang modulemaps.

methods.name: WritePCHCommands
methods.description: Writes build lines for precompiled headers, updating object and other files.

methods.name: WritePCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a precompiled header compile build line for a language.

methods.name: WriteGCCPCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a GCC-specific precompiled header command.

methods.name: WriteWindowsPCHCommand
methods.description: Writes a Windows-specific precompiled header command.

methods.name: WriteSources
methods.description: Writes source files, including handling of PCH dependencies and module info.

methods.name: WriteSwiftSources
methods.description: Handles writing of Swift source files.

methods.name: WriteSourceSetStamp
methods.description: Writes the stamp line for a source set, which is not linked.

methods.name: WriteLibsList
methods.description: Writes list of libraries for linking.

methods.name: WriteOrderOnlyDependencies
methods.description: Writes dependencies that must be built before others, excluding linkable dependencies.

methods.name: CheckForDuplicateObjectFiles
methods.description: Checks for duplicate object files in a list.
